However, they didn't mention that there were 85 refunded orders overall, but they filtered by status completed, so fine. They also didn't mention that revenue column had commas, but they handled conversion. So no major unacknowledged problem.

5. FALSE PREMISE: Premises to verify: 'loyal' is a valid customer_segment (true). completed orders are those with status == 'completed' (true). revenue is numeric in USD (originally string, but they converted). So premises hold.
